page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c2.medium is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type does not include bundled local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. It does not feature any integrated graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, focusing resources purely on CPU-bound execution.

With a one-to-one ratio of vCPUs to memory, the ecs.c2.medium is designed for compute-intensive workloads that require dedicated CPU resources but have low memory footprints. This hardware profile is suitable for tasks such as batch processing, high-performance computing nodes, and CPU-bound microservices. The primary tradeoff is the highly constrained memory capacity relative to the high core count, which makes it unsuitable for memory-intensive databases or large-scale data caching.
